column1: A waifu-collector with striking art but shallow, auto-driven combat and harsh progression. The CN release adds heavy censorship and aggressive monetization on top of fast power creep, leaving F2P players sidelined. Large client size, unstable downloads, and numerous technical/service issues further drag down the experience despite robust Live2D presentation and a cozy dorm loop.
